description: Per-dimension grading contract for the M4A readability + ACC-A floor scenario. Drives micro_breach at 200% UI scale + high contrast + captions + reduced_* flags through cf-e2e --verify-focus. Agent reads evidence (summary_grid.png + review_grid.png + observe.once/live-WS proof at 200% + events.jsonl + the resolved accessibility surface) and writes prose-justified scores.

dimensions.criterion: Every HUD line (STATUS / ITEM / HP / Reticle / STANCE / BODY / MODS / OBJECTIVE / MISSION / ENEMY / BREACH / TOOL / EVENT) is text-readable in the 200%-scale capture grid without overlap, clipping, missing-glyph boxes, or bottom-play-area obstruction.
High-contrast palette swap is visible: strip backgrounds shift to fully opaque pure black + text to pure white. Captions strip honors the same swap.
BODY silhouette line shows per-zone hp percentages with the placeholder marker `~` (M4A surface; M5 fills the real body graph). Values clamp to [0, 100] and respect HP changes.
MODS line shows weapon_mount + jet + shield + sensor placeholder slots. Weapon state reflects READY / RELOADING / EMPTY / NO RIFLE per the rifle bridge.

Banner stack renders critical > warning > info in priority order with severity word + icon glyph (color-independent). At least one banner should appear during the run (HP_LOW / AMMO_OUT / ARMOR_CRACKED), and banners must use the upper-right lane rather than covering the lower play/action area.

Caption strip is visible when captions=true and the queue has entries, hidden when captions=false or empty. Display::None / Display::Flex toggles per the live setting, and visible captions use the upper-right lane rather than covering the lower play/action area.
act.settings.set updates surface in observe.once + cf-ui within 1-2 ticks. UiScale + palette swap apply on the next frame.

200% UI scale reflows the HUD without overlap, clipping, missing-glyph boxes, bottom-play-area obstruction, or layout collapse. Bevy UiScale handles Val::Px reflow and cf-ui constrains status/banners/captions.

DR-012 ACC-A floor closes: 9 settings fields wired, 200% scale + high contrast + captions + reduced_* + hold_to_confirm + hold_threshold_ms + key_remap_enabled honored, color-independent state labels, focusable_nodes contract exposed via observe.accessibility, every status surface readable through cfctl.
DR-003 silhouette lean is proven via the BODY hud line + ActorView.body_silhouette projection + HudBodySilhouette resource. Placeholder marker is honest about M5 ownership.
cfctl observe --once exposes every M4A field: stance, body_silhouette, module_strip, banners, captions, tool_validity, accessibility (with focusable_nodes).

Run bundle has summary_grid.png + review_grid.png + their JSON companions + capture_manifest.json + events.jsonl + run_manifest.json (with settings reflecting the 200%/high-contrast/captions/reduced/hold/remap posture).
